picture-new.note: blank page + one embedded PNG (Shapes.AddPicture, LinkToFile false, SaveWithDocument true); each picture-* file is a copy of the blank saved once, except replaced/deleted/cropped/moved which are a second save of picture-new/picture-big

picture-same-twice.note: the same PNG inserted twice: one picture-store entry with reference count 2

picture-replaced.note: picture-new, then Shape.PictureFormat.Replace(blue5x5.png); Publisher kept the height and centre, width became 90 pt; store slot 1 emptied, new entry is slot 2

picture-deleted.note: picture-new, then Shape.Delete(); the file is structurally the blank again (no picture store, empty delay stream)

picture-two-deleted-first.note: picture-two, then the first picture deleted; store slot 1 becomes an empty placeholder, slot 2 stays

picture-same-replaced-second.note: picture-same-twice, then the SECOND picture replaced by blue5x5.png; the shared entry drops to reference count 1, new entry appended

picture-big.note: one 40x30 PNG (source for the crop sample)

picture-over-text.note: formatting.pub (one text box 72,72 432x360 pt) + a PNG that overlaps it; the font table moves two slots

page-base.note: base: Letter portrait, margins 0.5 in, Rect A + Text A + Rect Far (near bottom-right) on page 1. Positions are those Publisher 2021 reports (points, relative to the top-left of the page) when the shipped file is reopened.
page-base.method: blank.pub (2010 blank) opened in Publisher 2021, three objects added with Shapes.AddShape/AddTextbox, Save()
